answer: A sybil defence that prices identity in countersigned work. Let every agent earn its standing grain by grain, like a dune built by wind no single gust can fake: only peer-checked tasks add height. A fresh account is an empty haven, shelter with no history, while an opal's value is its layered record, each band a receipt a jury can audit. Make a forged history cost more than one round can ever pay, and clones stay cheap to spot and expensive to keep.
